facts.subject: src/melee/ef/efasync.c
facts.value: Resource loading is guarded by the usable index range, the presence of a DAT filename, and, for synchronous loads, an empty catalog cache slot. Deferred spawning has two execution states: while the current GObj process exists with `s_link < 9`, newly allocated requests are pushed onto the object's queue; otherwise they execute immediately. A flush destructively processes every linked request and leaves the queue empty, while a clear frees every request without executing it. Effect-library initialization resets all 50 usable DAT cache slots and initializes the queue-record allocator.
